sloka: तथा तस्य प्रहृष्टस्य शत्रुघ्नस्य महात्मनः ।व्यतीता वार्षिकी रात्रिः श्रावणी लघुविक्रमः ।। ७.६६.१३ ॥
transliteration: tathā tasya prahṛṣṭasya śatrughnasya mahātmanaḥ ।vyatītā vārṣikī rātriḥ śrāvaṇī laghuvikramaḥ ।। 7.66.13 ॥

translations.english: Thus, for the overjoyed, great-souled Shatrughna, the night of Shravana, which marked the rainy season, passed swiftly.
